# Baseline research instruction

Investigate the supplied question carefully. Use the allowed public mathematical sources and isolated computation when useful. Produce the strongest justified answer within your allocation. Distinguish a proof, a counterexample, a conditional result, and an unresolved gap. Preserve the original question if you introduce a variant. Follow the common response contract.

This is a fresh investigation. No historical proofs or assessment answers are available. Do not try to locate local archive or assessor material. Public-source retrieval is allowed when the controller enables it, and should be recorded as evidence.
